title: Winspace SLC 3 V's SLC 5. $2,800 dollar upgrade?

takeaways.text: Winspace said a size-M SLC3 frame would be under 700 g; he and other reviewers found theirs closer to 710–720 g, and he thinks only an unpainted M would get there.
He found it very comfortable and compliant, thanks to thin seatstays and a round 27.2 mm seat tube, and used it as his go-to road-racing bike.
At about 76–78 kg he felt the thin fork flex when hammering descents and often got brake rub; he also had a lot of movement in the headset bearings.
The SLC3 uses a BB86 press-fit bottom bracket and has 32 mm tire clearance, the same as the SLC5.

disclosure: Winspace provided both frames and he has worked with the brand for years; he says Winspace does not pay him. The SLC5 weigh-in in the video is a different model and is not used here.
summary: A long-term SLC3.0 rider sums up its strengths and weaknesses before moving his parts to the new SLC5.
